inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust on the pick, the vein runs dry
We chisel the stone, the timber sigh
A seam of black, a wall of bone
The iron gate isn't alone

[Chorus]
It speaks in tongues that haven't been born
A cold breath rising, a silent morn
The mouth of the earth, it opens wide
With nothing to hide, with nowhere to hide

[Verse]
The heavy door swings slow in the dark
A voice like gravel, a tearing mark
It knows our names before we are old
A story written in rust and gold

[Chorus]
It speaks in tongues that haven't been born
A cold breath rising, a silent morn
The mouth of the earth, it opens wide
With nothing to hide, with nowhere to hide

[Bridge]
We run for the light, but the light is gone
The roots have pulled, the night has won
The door seals shut with a thunderous crack
No turning back, no turning back

[Solo]

[Chorus]
It speaks in tongues that haven't been born
A cold breath rising, a silent morn
The mouth of the earth, it opens wide
With nothing to hide, with nowhere to hide

[Outro]
The mountain swallows our final breath
The voices stop, the dead are left
Silence
